verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Firecrawl publishes a structured llms.txt at docs.firecrawl.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its full v2/v1 documentation, giving agents a direct, machine-readable entry point to the product's docs, and the docs site also exposes per-page .md variants (e.g., mcp-server.md, webhooks/overview.md) confirming an agent-oriented docs architecture. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents actually consume this llms.txt successfully in practice, and no explicit vendor statement framing llms.txt as an agent-onboarding feature.
